review: The diagnostic kills only its own world process and pins its compositor before the crash.

The broker must remain alive and confirm authority before BUSY can establish an orphan reservation.
Explicit diagnostic release occurs only after native release and is not production recovery.
Only the new diagnostic method runs; inherited application-control tests are not duplicated.
Source and binaries are checked before and after execution. Test assertions remain unchanged.
limits: Direct fixture-retained broker channel, without configured recovery supervisor.
